item.title: 8 Marvel Studios Movies And TV Shows That Need To Be A Priority In The Post-AVENGERS: SECRET WARS MCU
item.description: Avengers: Secret Wars is expected to reboot the MCU, and with Marvel Studios slowing down on its big and small screen releases ahead of that movie's debut, these projects need to be a priority post-2027.

item.title: SUPERGIRL Will Reportedly Be A Lower Budget DC Movie; James Gunn Responds To Wonder Woman Casting Rumors
item.description: A new report suggests that DC Studios cut costs on Supergirl to ensure profitability. James Gunn, meanwhile, has debunked a recent Wonder Woman casting claim for Man of Tomorrow.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Directors Tell Fans To "Fear Doom" As Rumors Swirl About Misdirects In Teaser Trailers
item.description: Avengers: Doomsday directors Joe and Anthony Russo have warned fans to #FearDoom following today's teaser trailer release, but are these sneak peeks actually a misdirect?

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY X-Men Teaser Trailer Leaks Online In Much Higher Quality
item.description: The third Avengers: Doomsday teaser trailer has leaked online in much higher quality, offering fans a much closer look at Professor X, Magneto, and Cyclops.

item.title: ULTIMATE ENDGAME #1 Brings Back [SPOILER] In A Surprise New Role As The Maker Return In Horrifying Twist
item.description: Ultimate Endgame #1 went on sale today, and we're taking a deep dive into the debut issue's conclusion. That includes a shocking return and a wild new status quo for The Maker.

item.title: MCU Rumor Roundup: Doctor Doom's Female Sidekick, Ms. Marvel's MCU Future, AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Spoilers
item.description: In our latest MCU rumour roundup, we have news on Doctor Doom's female ally in Avengers: Doomsday, an update on plans for Ms. Marvel, and possible confirmation of a long-awaited clash.

item.title: RUMOR: DC Studios And James Gunn ARE In The Process Of Casting Wonder Woman For MAN OF TOMORROW
item.description: It's been widely speculated that DC Studios and James Gunn are looking to cast Wonder Woman for Man of Tomorrow, and a new rumour claims that the hunt for Diana Prince is indeed on.

item.title: THE BRAVE AND THE BOLD: 5 Ways DC Studios Can Guarantee The Long-Delayed Batman Reboot Succeeds
item.description: Since first being announced at the start of 2023, The Brave and the Bold has yet to materialise. However, there are some key steps that DC Studios needs to focus on to ensure it succeeds.
